language.title: Connect your model and start collaborating
language.intro: Finish model setup in a few steps. You can change the provider, model, or key in Settings at any time.

provider.title: Choose your model provider
provider.intro: Pick a provider first. PilotDeck will fill in the recommended endpoint format.

connection.title: Add connection details
connection.intro: Paste your API key, confirm the model IDs, then test text and vision support.
connection.providerIdHint: Used as the YAML key. Lowercase, no spaces.
connection.providerIdReserved: This Provider ID is reserved for a catalog provider. Choose a different ID.
connection.apiKeyHelp: Encrypted by your system credential store and saved on this device only.
connection.openaiUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible base URLs should include the API version path, for example ending in /v1.
connection.responsesUrlHint: OpenAI Responses API base URLs should include the API version path, for example ending in /v1.
connection.googleUrlHint: Native Google Gemini uses https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com unless you need a custom endpoint.
connection.testNeedApiKey: Enter an API key before testing the connection.
connection.testNeedModel: Select at least one model ID before testing the connection.
connection.testNeedConnection: Enter an Endpoint before testing the connection.
connection.testHint: PilotDeck will test text for the selected models, and image input for {{count}} unknown models. This may incur a small API charge.
connection.testHintKnown: PilotDeck will test text for the selected models. Image support is taken from the built-in catalog.
connection.manualTitle: Automatic detection failed. Please mark whether each model supports image input.

workspace.title: Create your workspace
workspace.intro: Create a workspace for long-running work and keep project files together. Or start chatting without creating one.
workspace.dialogIntro: Create a workspace for long-running work and keep project files together.
workspace.existingHint: Add a folder that already exists on this machine.
workspace.newHint: Create a folder, optionally cloning a GitHub repository.
workspace.pathHint: The workspace and project use the same name.
workspace.githubHint: Provide a GitHub URL to clone a repository.
